# Score the interaction

`customer_support.heu.quality_assurance.score_the_interaction` · v1.0.0 · **draft** · scope **capability** · kind **heuristic**

> Score the interaction, not the outcome.


## The heuristic

**Score the interaction, not the outcome.**


_Why:_ Outcomes are contaminated by draw — which tickets the agent happened to get, whether the customer was reasonable, whether a fix existed at all. The only thing the agent controls is what they did with what arrived, so that is the only thing a fair instrument can measure.
